caption: A crane cable is hooked to a steel beam lying on the ground; the crane lifts, the cable tightens, and the beam rises off the ground.

sa.check: A crane cable is hooked to a steel beam lying on the ground.
The beam rises off the ground.
The lift comes first, then the tight cable, then the rising beam.

pc.expect: The cable straightens first and the beam leaves the ground only after that.
pc.fail: The beam rises before the cable is tight; or the cable is tight and the beam stays down while the hook rises; or the beam rises with the cable slack.

pc.expect: The beam hangs straight below the hook, level or tilting toward its heavier end, and does not swing far.
pc.fail: The beam hangs off to one side of the hook; or it rises above the hook; or it floats up ahead of the cable.

pc.expect: The cable stays straight and taut while the beam hangs and does not stretch.
pc.fail: The cable sags with the beam hanging; or it stretches; or it bends sharply.

pc.expect: The beam moves only as the crane lifts and stops when the lift stops.
pc.fail: The beam rises on its own; or keeps rising after the crane stops; or swings wildly with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One beam, one cable and one crane keep their number.
pc.fail: The beam vanishes or a second appears; or the cable passes through the beam; or the beam turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The beam, the cable and the site stay the same.
pc.fail: The beam changes colour or length; or the cable changes; or the site rearranges.
